changeSet.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE doomed_root AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE deleted = false AND parent_id IS NULL AND ( name = 'sys.nav.portal.visualization' OR path = 'visualization' OR metadata ILIKE '%"title":"数据可视化"%' OR metadata ILIKE '%"titlekey":"sys.nav.portal.visualization"%' OR metadata ILIKE '%"sectionkey":"visualization"%' ) ), doomed AS ( SELECT id FROM doomed_root UNION ALL SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN doomed d ON m.parent_id = d.id ) DELETE FROM portal_menu_visibility v WHERE v.menu_id IN (SELECT id FROM doomed);
WITH RECURSIVE doomed_root AS ( SELECT id FROM portal_menu WHERE deleted = false AND parent_id IS NULL AND ( name = 'sys.nav.portal.visualization' OR path = 'visualization' OR metadata ILIKE '%"title":"数据可视化"%' OR metadata ILIKE '%"titlekey":"sys.nav.portal.visualization"%' OR metadata ILIKE '%"sectionkey":"visualization"%' ) ), doomed AS ( SELECT id FROM doomed_root UNION ALL SELECT m.id FROM portal_menu m JOIN doomed d ON m.parent_id = d.id ) UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = true WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM doomed);
